name: Maher-shalal-hash-baz
bio: Maher-shalal-hash-baz, meaning "the spoil speeds, the prey hastens," was the son born to Isaiah and the prophetess at the LORD's command, witnessed by Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberechiah. His name served as a sign that Damascus and Samaria would be plundered by Assyria before he was old enough to speak (Isaiah 8:1-4).
